title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: finitarytree
text:
finitary tree
finitary tree
(data structure)
Definition:
A
tree
with a finite number of
children
at every
node
.
Note:
As opposed to infinitary trees which may have an infinite number of children at some nodes.

PEB
